reachRule: Pikes may kill an adjacent enemy without moving; poke consumes the action; advance-capture remains legal
fitnessRule: population-normalized speed-sensitive natural-elimination score; Hunter target population 6x; Horse/Archer Lords multiply by normalized recruit fraction and sqrt(population-normalized specialized-unit kill share); Pike Lords multiply by sqrt(normalized mean pikes trained/game) and sqrt(population-normalized pike kill share); Pike Lords and Hunters multiply natural-elimination winning games by (1+sqrt(enemy target units trained)); Hunters mitigate elimination-loss penalty by up to 50% according to sqrt(target units killed/(1+target units trained)) and receive up to +0.25 on draws by the same coverage term

selected.name: Pike Hunter Reach R28 Lottery Child 11

migration.sameGenerationBreeding: migrants occupy survivor slots but do not breed until next generation

breedingRules.survival: top 14 parent-generation residents under current fitness, minus outgoing top14 migrants, plus incoming migrants
breedingRules.earnedFatherhood: parent ranks1-7 one guaranteed child; ranks1-3 one additional; outgoing migrants forfeit same-generation fatherhood
breedingRules.parentLottery: 1/sqrt(parent rank), residents excluding outgoing migrants; incoming migrants sit out this breeding cycle
breedingRules.inheritance: 40% father / 40% mother / 10% mean / 5% uniform-between / 5% expanded-range mutation; self 95/5
breedingRules.mutationRange: locus-specific 3x expanded original seven-ecology G0 founder source range
breedingRules.wildcards: five independent 50% activation slots; all loci uniform in expanded founder range
